lines.en: label bar10:
scene sarabar1
I enter the bar to be greeted by a tragic sight.
lines.zh: 我走进酒吧，迎接我的是一幅惨不忍睹的景象。

lines.en: It seems that Sana has aged fifteen years or so since the last time I've seen her.
lines.zh: 看起来 Sana 自我上次见她以来，老了大概十五岁。

lines.en: I contemplate to myself the possibility of her concealing a tragic hormonal disease from me, but then remember the key detail of her being a human being.
lines.zh: 我在心里琢磨，她该不会是瞒着我得了什么可怕的内分泌疾病吧，随即想起了一个关键细节：她是人类。

lines.en: Which means that, more than likely, this is the original owner of her DNA.
lines.zh: 也就是说，眼前这位多半是她 DNA 的原始提供者。

lines.en: In other words, it looks like Sana's mom is working tonight.
lines.zh: 换句话说，看来今晚是 Sana 的妈妈在值班。

lines.en: : Well...hi!
lines.zh: : 哎呀……你好！

lines.en: : Can't say I've seen you around before.
lines.zh: : 我可要说，以前没在这儿见过你。

lines.en: : Come on over. I don't bite.
lines.zh: : 过来坐吧。我又不咬人。

lines.en: scene sarabar2
: What can I get you? As a heads up, we're pretty low on...a lot of things right now.
lines.zh: : 想喝点什么？先说好，我们现在……挺多东西都缺。

lines.en: : Just a beer is fine, thanks.
lines.zh: : 一杯啤酒就行，谢谢。

lines.en: : Coming right up.
lines.zh: : 马上来。

lines.en: scene sarabar0
The woman heads over to the cooler and grabs the same beer I always have when I'm here.
lines.zh: 女人走到冷藏柜前，拿了我每次来都喝的那款啤酒。

lines.en: Not like there are any options to begin with, but at least it's one that I've come around to enjoying.
lines.zh: 反正本来也没什么可选，不过至少这一款我已经慢慢喝出感情来了。

lines.en: scene sarabar3
: Aaaand one beer. Want me to leave your tab open or are you gonna be a loser and abandon me after one drink?
lines.zh: : 好啦，一杯啤酒。要我给你挂账呢，还是你打算当个没劲的家伙，喝完一杯就抛下我？

lines.en: : Well, I {i}was{/i} thinking about being a loser tonight, but with words like {i}abandon{/i} sneaking into the conversation, I don't know if I should anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我今晚{i}本来{/i}打算当个没劲的家伙的，不过既然话里都用上“{i}抛下{/i}”这种词了，我就不确定还要不要这么做了。

lines.en: scene sarabar4
: That’s the spirit! Plus, now you get to hang out with me free of charge. And that's something I make everyone else pay extra for, you know.
lines.zh: : 这就对了！再说了，现在你可以免费跟我待着。这可是我向其他所有人额外收费的项目哦。

lines.en: Add that to the list of reasons this bar is failing, I guess.
lines.zh: 我看，这也能加进这家酒吧经营惨淡的原因清单里了。

lines.en: : Thanks a lot for the discount. I feel even less inclined to abandon you now.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你的折扣。我现在更不想抛下你了。

lines.en: scene sarabar3
: Don’t mention it. It's not every day somebody like you walks in.
lines.zh: : 别客气。像你这样的人可不是天天都有的。

lines.en: : You mean a customer?
lines.zh: : 你是指客人？

lines.en: scene sarabar4r
: Well, uhh...I was {i}going{/i} to say somebody handsome. But...yeah. I guess what you said is...just as accurate.
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……我{i}本来{/i}想说的是英俊的人。不过……是啊。你说的……好像也一样准确。

lines.en: : At least we're known for {i}something,{/i} I guess. I would have preferred it didn't involve how dead the place is, but I guess beggars can't be choosers.
lines.zh: : 至少我们还因为{i}某样东西{/i}出了名，我想。我倒宁愿不是因为这家店有多冷清，不过乞丐总没得挑。

lines.en: : I only know because I've become sort of a regular here. There's no word on the street about the place or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道是因为我已经算是这里的常客了。街上可没人在传这家店的什么消息之类的。

lines.en: Though, I can't imagine it wouldn't help if there was.
lines.zh: 不过我想，真有人传的话，多少还是会有点帮助的。

lines.en: scene sarabar5
: Wait, you're a regular {i}here{/i}? At this bar? The one we're currently inside of?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是{i}这里{/i}的常客？在这家酒吧？在我们现在所在的这家？

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t have us confused with some other place?
lines.zh: : 你确定你没有把这里跟别的什么地方搞混吗？

lines.en: : It's definitely this place. I'm sure.
lines.zh: : 绝对是这家。我很确定。

lines.en: : It’s just weird that I’ve never seen you before if you’re a regular...
lines.zh: : 可你要是常客，我却从没见过你，这就很奇怪了……

lines.en: : That's probably because the younger version of you is typically the one who helps me.
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为平时招待我的都是年轻版的你。

lines.en: scene sarabar4
: Aww! My sweet little girl Sana is- wait. You're not saying I look old, are you?
lines.zh: : 哎呀！我可爱的小女儿 Sana 是——等等。你该不会是在说我看起来老吧？

lines.en: : You look very young. Just...also understandably older than the smallest girl I know.
lines.zh: : 你看起来非常年轻。只是……也理所当然比我认识的最娇小的那个女孩年长一些。

lines.en: : She's doing okay, then? I had no idea she'd been actually helping anybody lately.
lines.zh: : 那她还好吗？我都不知道她最近居然真的有在招待客人。

lines.en: : She’s...doing her best. She needs a little work still, but I’m helping her get there.
lines.zh: : 她……已经很努力了。她还需要再练练，不过我在帮她往那个方向走。

lines.en: scene sarabar5
: Helping her get there? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 帮她往那个方向走？你是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that, as her teacher, I can't let her permanently struggle when it comes to common social skills.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，作为她的老师，我不能眼睁睁看她在基本的社交能力上一直吃力下去。

lines.en: scene sarabar6
: Oh my god, {i}you're{/i} Sana's teacher?! It’s so nice to finally meet you!
lines.zh: : 天哪，你{i}就是{/i} Sana 的老师？！终于见到你了，太高兴了！

lines.en: : I’m Sara! I always figured our first meeting would be, like...not inside of my bar.
lines.zh: : 我是 Sara！我一直以为我们第一次见面会是在……比如说，不在我的酒吧里。

lines.en: : Life can be unpredictable at times, I guess. Meeting here is much more interesting than in my office, at the very least.
lines.zh: : 人生有时候就是难以预料吧。至少在这儿见面比在我的办公室里有意思多了。

lines.en: scene sarabar5
: I’m really surprised, though. All this time, I was under the impression you were a woman. You're so young, too.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的很意外。这么久以来，我一直以为你是位女性。而且你还这么年轻。

lines.en: : How old are you? If you don’t mind me asking, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你多大了？我是说，如果你不介意我问的话。

lines.en: : Uhh...
...How old {i}am{/i} I?
lines.zh: ……{i}我{/i}多大了？

lines.en: I spit out the first number that comes to mind.
lines.zh: 我把脑海里冒出来的第一个数字说了出来。

lines.en: I should probably ask Ami if I have an ID tucked away anywhere, since I don't think I've seen it since starting my new life.
lines.zh: 我大概该去问问 Ami，我有没有把身份证塞在什么地方，因为开始新生活之后我好像就没再见过它了。

lines.en: scene sarabar6
: Wow! That means you and me are almost the same age! I can’t believe Sana never told me!
lines.zh: : 哇！那我们俩几乎同岁啊！真不敢相信 Sana 居然从来没告诉过我！

lines.en: : What {i}I{/i} can’t believe is that you're a mother. You could probably pass as one of my students if you wanted to.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}不敢相信的是你居然是个母亲。你要是愿意，大概可以冒充我的学生。

lines.en: scene sarabar3
: Well, I {i}do{/i} still fit in my old uniform if you ever wanna test that theory out a little more...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我{i}还{/i}穿得下以前那套校服呢，要是你想把这个理论验证得更充分一点……

lines.en: : ...is what I {i}would{/i} be saying if I was not such a dedicated mother who always puts her daughter first!
lines.zh: : ……如果我不是那么一位全心全意、永远把女儿放在第一位的称职母亲，我{i}就会{/i}这么说！

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. The only reason I went silent is because I was fantasizing.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我之所以沉默，是因为我在浮想联翩。

lines.en: scene sarabar6r
: Oh, thank god. I thought I set a new record for the time between an introduction and a fallout for a second.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。我刚才还以为我创下了从自我介绍到翻脸用时最短的新纪录呢。

lines.en: Did Sana really come out of this woman? The two of them couldn't be any further apart.
lines.zh: Sana 真的是这个女人生的吗？她们俩简直没有半点相似之处。

lines.en: scene sarabar7
: Mom, I finished cleaning the glasses. Did you want me to-
lines.zh: : 妈妈，杯子我都擦完了。你要我——

lines.en: : Hi, Sana.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sana。

lines.en: scene sarabar8
: Ah-
: Oh...I...I see that...
lines.zh: : 哦……我……我看到了……

lines.en: : I finally met your mom, yes.
lines.zh: : 对，我终于见到你妈妈了。

lines.en: scene sarabar9
: Hey! You let me think your teacher was a woman this whole time and never even bothered correcting me! How come?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你让我这么多年来一直以为你的老师是位女性，居然都懒得纠正我！为什么？！

lines.en: : I...just...I don't know...
lines.zh: : 我……只是……我不知道……

lines.en: : Any other mom would totally ground you right now, you know. You’re lucky I'm the best.
lines.zh: : 换个别的妈妈，这会儿早就把你禁足了，你知道吧。算你运气好，我是最好的妈妈。

lines.en: : R-Right...
lines.zh: : 是、是哦……

lines.en: scene sarabar10
: So, are there any good stories about Sana from[school]? Please tell me if there are.
lines.zh: : 那么，Sana 在[school]有什么好玩的事吗？有的话一定要告诉我。

lines.en: scene sarabar11
: Mom! Stop! I already told you...I don’t really talk to anyone...
lines.zh: : 妈妈！别说了！我都跟你说过了……我不怎么跟人说话的……

lines.en: scene sarabar12
: Well, that's not true! What about that cute blonde girl that comes over sometimes?
lines.zh: : 才不是呢！那偶尔来我们家那个可爱的金发女孩呢？

lines.en: : Oh! Ayane! That was her name. I think.
lines.zh: : 哦！Ayane！她叫这个名字。我记得。

lines.en: : Or...Ayaka?
lines.zh: : 还是……Ayaka？

lines.en: : Anya?...
lines.zh: : Anya？……

lines.en: scene sarabar13
: It's...Ayane...
lines.zh: : 是……Ayane……

lines.en: Poor Sana. It seems like even she has trouble dealing with how outgoing her mother is.
lines.zh: 可怜的 Sana。看来连她都应付不了自己妈妈这么外向的性格。

lines.en: Luckily for her, I'm going to decide {i}against{/i} embarrassing her in front of her mother as I believe it will increase the chances of her eventually sleeping with me.
lines.zh: 不过对她来说幸运的是，我决定{i}不{/i}在她妈妈面前让她难堪，因为我觉得这样能提高她最终跟我上床的概率。

lines.en: Ulterior motives reign supreme once again.
lines.zh: 别有用心的动机再次占了上风。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t have any interesting stories to share, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我这边没什么有意思的故事可以分享，遗憾。

lines.en: scene sarabar14
: Awe! Darn it! If anything happens, though, you have to let me know. That's a new rule starting right now.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！可恶！不过要是发生了什么，你一定得告诉我。这是从现在开始的新规矩。

lines.en: scene sarabar15
: Oh! I know! I’ll give you my number so you don't have any excuse not to!
lines.zh: : 哦！我知道了！我把号码给你，这样你就没有借口不联系我了！

lines.en: : Mom! Stop! Sensei doesn’t want your number!
lines.zh: : 妈妈！别这样！老师才不想要你的号码！

lines.en: : Doesn't he need it, though? I'm your emergency contact and I need to know if something bad ever happens.
lines.zh: : 可他不是需要吗？我是你的紧急联系人，万一出了什么坏事我得知道。

lines.en: : Being able to hear embarrassing stories with the push of a button is just an unfortunate side effect, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: : 至于按个按钮就能听到让人害臊的故事，恐怕只是个不幸的副作用。

lines.en: Sara swiftly scribbles her number on a sheet of receipt paper and somehow slides it over to me without Sana noticing.
lines.zh: Sara 麻利地把号码草草写在一张收银纸上，不知怎么地就滑到了我面前，Sana 完全没察觉。

lines.en: Despite what her daughter says, I gladly accept it.
lines.zh: 尽管她女儿反对，我还是欣然收下了。

lines.en: : Mom!
lines.zh: : 妈妈！

lines.en: : What’s the problem, dear? I’m just trying to keep tabs on my precious little girl.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，亲爱的？我只是想盯紧我宝贝的小女儿。

lines.en: : I can...take care of myself!
lines.zh: : 我……能照顾好自己！

lines.en: scene sarabar16
: Besides...Sensei...would...never let anything bad happen to me...so...
lines.zh: : 而且……老师……绝对……不会让我遇到什么坏事的……所以……

lines.en: scene sarabar17
: Well, well, well...
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀呀……

lines.en: : What do we have here?
lines.zh: : 这是怎么回事啊？

lines.en: Sara shoots me a slightly suggestive glance as Sana looks away from us.
lines.zh: Sana 把头转向别处时，Sara 朝我投来一个略带挑逗意味的眼神。

lines.en: And, without beating around the bush, I'm pretty sure it's her insinuating that her daughter might have a little crush on me.
lines.zh: 而且不用拐弯抹角，我敢肯定她是在暗示她女儿可能对我有点意思。

lines.en: I doubt it's true, but I'm not going to argue it because I want it to be.
lines.zh: 我怀疑这不是真的，但我不会去反驳，因为我巴不得它是真的。

lines.en: : So...{i}Sensei...{/i}my little girl seems to believe that you’ll protect her from the evils of life. Is this true?
lines.zh: : 那么……{i}老师{/i}……我家小女儿似乎相信你会保护她免受生活的种种邪恶。是真的吗？

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m sorry my mom talks so much...
lines.zh: : 老师……对不起，我妈妈话太多了……

lines.en: : Her...brain is...um...
lines.zh: : 她的……脑子……嗯……

lines.en: : She has an...illness that makes her...say things and...
lines.zh: : 她得了一种……会让她……乱说话的病，而且……

lines.en: : Oh, stop. I do not.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。我没有。

lines.en: scene sarabar18
: Sensei, you know I'm not sick, right?
lines.zh: : 老师，你知道我没病，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I don't {i}know{/i} that...but based on my experiences tonight, I have no reason to assume you are?...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我也不{i}知道{/i}……不过根据今晚的经历，我没什么理由认为你有病？……

lines.en: : Exactly!
lines.zh: : 就是嘛！

lines.en: : I'm just a totally normal super cool, super young, supermom.
lines.zh: : 我只是个完全正常的、超酷、超年轻、超级妈妈。

lines.en: : And if my daughter trusts you with her well-being, I guess I do too.
lines.zh: : 而且既然我女儿愿意把自己的安危托付给你，那我想我也一样。

lines.en: : Welcome to the bar, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到这家酒吧，老师。

lines.en: : I imagine we'll be seeing each other quite often from now on.
lines.zh: : 我想从今往后我们会经常见面的。

lines.en: : I...really hope not...
lines.zh: : 我……真的希望不会……

lines.en: scene black
I wind up staying for a few more drinks and chatting with Sara about all sorts of things.
lines.zh: 我又留下来多喝了几杯，跟 Sara 天南地北地聊了一通。

lines.en: She’s the first person my age that I’ve felt some sort of connection with. And she {i}does{/i} genuinely seem to care about Sana in that ‘overbearing mom’ sort of way.
lines.zh: 她是我来这里之后第一个让我产生某种共鸣的同龄人。而且她{i}确实{/i}真心关心 Sana，就是那种“强势老妈”式的关心。

lines.en: The two of them are like oil and water. You know they won't work well together, but the immense curiosity of combining two incompatible components is enough to pique your curiosity.
lines.zh: 她们俩就像油和水。你知道它们合不到一起，但把两种互不相容的东西混在一起会怎样，这种巨大的好奇心足以勾起人的兴趣。

lines.en: The night moves on and I observe as their respective spills combine.
lines.zh: 夜色渐深，我看着她们各自泼洒出来的液体汇合在一起。

lines.en: I feel no need to clean anything up.
lines.zh: 我觉得没必要去收拾什么。

lines.en: I simply enjoy a few more drinks and then head home.
lines.zh: 我只是又享受了几杯，然后就回家了。

lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}
